context: Refactors the sum() helper to use a for...in loop instead of a classic index loop, and adds a describe() summary function.
explanation: for...in enumerates enumerable property keys, including inherited ones and any extra properties attached to the array (or its prototype), not just numeric indices in order. If any code or library adds a custom property to Array.prototype, or the array is sparse, sum() will iterate over unexpected keys and either throw, produce NaN, or silently include garbage values. Array summation should use a for loop, for...of, or reduce, all of which iterate values in order.
